comparison_principle: All four arms share world-road unit seeds and geometry plus v3 ownership/body/leakage/densification. Only multiview-query and continuous-prior source weights differ; not directly comparable to old V2 same-named arms.

fixed_regions.front_occlusion: valid measured depth inside the five-actor body mask
fixed_regions.dynamic_strict_outside: outside a two-pixel dilation of the five-actor mask
fixed_regions.observed_road: permanent world query units with at least two hard-eligible sources, provenance1
fixed_regions.prior_road: supported world query units with zero hard-eligible sources, provenance2; not GT
fixed_regions.unknown: unsupported or single-view-unconfirmed units, provenance0; no road RGB target
fixed_regions.outside_query: outside the automatic all49 five-car world query; raw89 a6/a37 also reported as fixed subcohorts

required_numeric_reports: V1 static_duration, static_velocity and NPS: raw, weighted and gradient diagnostics
non-edit context vehicles and unknown regions: full49 appearance and motion retention
all three native background temporal gradients; stable surfaces and non-target motion evaluated separately
body joint RGB L1 and structural loss
front static hard fraction and opacity mass
dynamic strict-outside raw color mean and top one percent
dynamic color-to-alpha ratio excess mean and top one percent
prior continuity, boundary RGB and surface geometry energy; no invented hidden-road RGB PSNR
source-wise hard gates, effective weights, actual RGB objective visits and sampled gradient norms
same world-unit source-exclusion paired differences only after separately approved full30K controls
extra source raster calls, time, peak memory and fixed road-unit share of native point cap
static and dynamic point counts plus branch/joint densification selection counts
required_human_review: non-target vehicle motion and appearance retained in the background over all49 frames
trusted stable road and building geometry across time
observed-road, prior-road, unknown, and outside-query crops on a shared timeline
invalid_claims: the whole background must have zero fixed-camera time variation
training completion means visual quality passed
one full-frame ranking proves one road source has higher unit quality
unknown regions are supervised road ground truth
low dynamic alpha alone proves no visible dynamic leakage
the screen-depth surrogate is exact per-splat front contribution
candidate weights or gradients prove a source improved final quality
a6 unexposed prior is uniquely recovered true road texture
same30K updates means the added multi-source rendering has zero compute overhead
